Disk storage for BitTorrent downloads.

Maps pieces to file regions and handles reading/writing to disk. Supports both single-file and multi-file torrents.

Imports

metainfo, sha1

Types

StorageError = object of CatchableError
StorageManager = ref object
  baseDir*: string
  info*: TorrentInfo
